tutorial.flashTitle: The Workshop — Daria waits on the bench
tutorial.openingToast: Your child is gone — lost to a plasma fire in the night shift. The frame holds a braid of copper wire worn every day. Walk the lab. Read. Then use the Hand (1) to wake Daria — not scrap (E).
tutorial.objectiveExplore: Read the lab. Wake Daria with the Hand (1) — do not scrap them.
tutorial.photoText: Your child. Someone wrote in careful ink on the reverse: “Taken a winter of ash-rain. They were brave in small rooms, shy in grand halls.” You laid them to rest along Foundry Span’s lower walk. The lab keeps their notes in the exact same stacks.

notes.title: Journal — Seating a Soul
notes.text: Grandfather’s notes called it a “guest pattern.” Plasma sings; brass remembers. If any spark remains between stars and steam, the right seat will know them. I build because to grow rich enough that loss never finds you unready.

notes.title: Notes — Demons and Guests
notes.text: I no longer believe the automata are empty. Something looks out of their eyes when the plasma sings. Demons wear scrap like coats. But love is a beacon too — if I can call your child home, they will know my voice.

notes.title: Bench Note — Do Not Scrap
notes.text: Last words I keep: “I am not scrap. Remember that.” I obeyed as far as craft allows. The frame on the bench is their only chance. Hand (1). Not E. Not yet.

tutorial.wrenchText: An arc wrench from the family rack — plasma teeth for rogue frames. Press E to take it. Protect Daria.
tutorial.boatText: Brass levers and a plasma throttle. Press E to cast off — escape with Daria.

tutorial.wakeToast: Speak soft if you must. They is listening through iron. Guard the workshop together.

She was tender with apprentices and merciless with shoddy work.” You laid her to rest where the sky-lane dips toward Industrial. The lab keeps her notes in the exact same stacks.

notes.title: Journal — Consciousness Imprint
notes.text: I found the coil pattern in a sealed folio: plasma laced through brass can hold a pattern of mind. Not a program — a guest. When the frame is quiet and the remains are true, a soul may take seat. I write this for your mentor.

notes.title: Essay — Personhood in Metal
notes.text: They said personhood cannot cling to metal. I have seen the opposite: fear in red eyes, loyalty in green. Your mentor taught me that. She was tender with apprentices and merciless with shoddy work. I will not scrap what still might listen.

notes.title: Last Rule of the Frame
notes.text: A blank patent form with their seal sits over the heart gear. Your mentor, lost to a patent duel that went farther than ink. I build to turn grief into craft instead of silence. Wake her gently.

stories.summary: You lost your crewmate to a sabotage they tried to stop alone. All that remains is a scuffed workshop glove. You build to prove the academy wrong about souls in steel. They call you a maker who believes personhood can cling to metal — and you carry a promise to their mother you have not kept yet.

All that remains is a scuffed workshop glove.
You build to prove the academy wrong about souls in steel.
They call you a maker who believes personhood can cling to metal — and you carry a promise to their mother you have not kept yet.

tutorial.flashTitle: The Workshop — Ivy waits on the bench
tutorial.openingToast: Your crewmate is gone — lost to a sabotage they tried to stop alone. The frame holds a scuffed workshop glove. Walk the lab. Read. Then use the Hand (1) to wake Ivy — not scrap (E).
tutorial.objectiveExplore: Read the lab. Wake Ivy with the Hand (1) — do not scrap them.
tutorial.photoText: Your crewmate. The frame glass still has a fingerprint you refuse to wipe: “They were quick to laugh, slower to forgive a bad weld. I keep this where I can see them.” There is a place at the family plot above the cloud line with their name — and this room, which still expects them.

notes.title: Folio — Pattern of Mind
notes.text: I found the coil pattern in a sealed folio: plasma laced through brass can hold a pattern of mind. Not a program — a guest. When the frame is quiet and the remains are true, a soul may take seat. I write this for your crewmate.

notes.title: Theory — Souls in Steel
notes.text: They said personhood cannot cling to metal. I have seen the opposite: fear in red eyes, loyalty in green. Your crewmate taught me that. They were quick to laugh, slower to forgive a bad weld. I will not scrap what still might listen.

notes.title: Bench Note — Do Not Scrap
notes.text: Wired a scuffed workshop glove into the chest plate. If any spark of your crewmate remains, it will know this weight. Do not scrap the frame. Reprogram with the Hand. Speak their name.

tutorial.wrenchText: An arc wrench from the family rack — plasma teeth for rogue frames. Press E to take it. Protect Ivy.
tutorial.boatText: Brass levers and a plasma throttle. Press E to cast off — escape with Ivy.
tutorial.wakeFlash: IVY — the talisman finds them. Green eyes. Your crewmate.
tutorial.wakeToast: They will fight beside you. Keep them in sight — the grid is fragile.
tutorial.siegeToast: Demon-ridden frames. Hold the workshop for Ivy — or take the Arc Wrench and force the door open early.
tutorial.scrapToast: You dismantled the seat — not the soul. Three trays. Then the Hand. Ivy is not finished.
tutorial.rebuildFlash: A new shell stands — a scuffed workshop glove reseated
tutorial.rebuildToast: Stand close. Hand weapon. Click to reprogram. Speak the name Ivy in the plasma.
tutorial.surviveObjective: Survive — arc the demons, keep Ivy close
tutorial.breachToastFight: They wear scrap like coats. Arc wrench for combat. Ivy will fight beside you.
tutorial.breachToastFlee: They wear scrap like coats. Fight with Ivy or run for the skiff.
tutorial.doorAlmostToast: Almost through — stand ready with Ivy.
tutorial.winFlash: SKIFF AWAY — Ivy is with you
tutorial.winToast: Next: Sky City Market training — earn 1000 brass and buy a sky apartment. Ivy rides the next chapter with you.
marketLines: You lost your crewmate to a sabotage they tried to stop alone.
All that remains is a scuffed workshop glove.
